Class TestCompilations

java.lang.Object
com.google.errorprone.TestCompilations
public final class TestCompilations extends Object

Shared helpers for configuring compiler options and creating JavacTaskImpl instances in Error Prone tests.

Intended for internal use by Error Prone test helpers only.

    Method
    Description
    static com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<String>
    defaultTestArgs(List<String> extraArgs)
    Returns extraArgs prefixed with Error Prone's preferred test defaults and -proc:none (unless annotation processing is explicitly configured in extraArgs).
    static com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<String>
    defaultTestArgs(List<String> extraArgs, boolean disableImplicitProcessing)
    Returns extraArgs prefixed with Error Prone's preferred test defaults and, when disableImplicitProcessing is true and annotation processing is not explicitly configured in extraArgs, -proc:none.
    static com.sun.tools.javac.api.JavacTaskImpl
    getTask(Writer out, DiagnosticListener<? super JavaFileObject> diagnosticListener, List<String> extraJavacArgs, Iterable<? extends JavaFileObject> compilationUnits)
    Creates a JavacTaskImpl using FileManagers.testFileManager() with Error Prone's required production javac options and preferred test defaults layered before extraJavacArgs.
    static com.sun.tools.javac.api.JavacTaskImpl
    getTask(Writer out, DiagnosticListener<? super JavaFileObject> diagnosticListener, List<String> extraJavacArgs, Iterable<? extends JavaFileObject> compilationUnits, com.sun.tools.javac.util.Context context)
    Creates a JavacTaskImpl using FileManagers.testFileManager() and the given context, with Error Prone's required production javac options and preferred test defaults layered before extraJavacArgs.
    static com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<String>
    withTestOnlyAndDeps(List<String> args, boolean testOnly)
    Augments args with -XepCompilingTestOnlyCode (when testOnly is true) and the com.google.errorprone.deps_for_test_inputs classpath (when set).
